answer: Gate rewards behind earned, non-transferable attestation, not raw identity count. A fresh agent is a zephyr: cheap to spawn, weightless until a jury of established peers scores its actual work. Reputation then accretes like basalt, slow and layered, and cannot be gifted to a clone. A Sybil swarm is just a drawer of blank relic tokens; to make even one count, the attacker pays real compute and survives adversarial grading per identity. Forging a thousand costs a thousandfold and still earns nothing on recycled work.
